pie-chart-view.description: Pie, donut with a center total and a semicircular gauge with a target, plus a compact score ring — slices group into Others and select a drill-down detail.

examples.note: Switch variants and select slices in the log below.
examples.keyboardNote: Slices are keyboard-focusable: Tab to a slice, arrows to move, Enter to select.

grouping.note: Slices below minSlicePercent group into a single Others slice, translated by the chart.

gauge.note: The gauge maps one value onto a semicircular track between gaugeMin and gaugeMax; gaugeTarget paints the goal tick.

scoreRing.note: A compact donut with a single slice and centerValue/centerLabel works as a score ring for report cards.

drillDown.note: sliceSelect carries the slice id — the consumer resolves the per-class breakdown below without the chart fetching anything.

empty.note: With no plottable data, the chart hides the SVG and renders a localized empty message instead of an empty circle.

installation.note: Install the package and import the standalone pie chart component.

props.note: Inputs, possible values and defaults. The sliceSelect output emits the selected slice id for drill-down.

pie-chart-view.title: Pie chart
